item.title: President Lee to Visit Marine Corps Division Tomorrow... 'Security Drive' for Korean War Remembrance Week (이 대통령, 내일 해병부대 찾는다…6·25 주간 ‘안보 드라이브’)
item.description:
The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 23rd that President Lee Jae-myung will hold a series of security-related events to mark Korean War Remembrance Week. (이재명 대통령이 6·25 주간을 맞아 안보 일정을 잇달아 진행할 예정이라고 23일 청와대가 밝혔다.)

On the 24th, President Lee plans to visit a Marine Corps division and inspect other security sites. On the 25th, he will attend the 76th anniversary ceremony of the Korean War and a reception for veterans and their families. On the 26th, he will chair a strategy meeting to foster future-oriented innovative security enterprises. (이 대통령은 24일 해병 부대 방문 등 안보 현장을 시찰하고, 25일에는 6·25 전쟁 76주년 기념식과 참전용사·유가족 위로연에 참석한다. 26일에는 미래 신안보 혁신기업을 육성하기 위한 전략회의를 주재한다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said, "These events are arranged to honor the heroes of the Korean War and to emphasize stronger national defense through robust security and innovation, coinciding with Korean War Remembrance Week and the Month of Patriots and Veterans." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 6·25 전쟁일 주간과 호국보훈의 달을 맞아 호국 영웅들을 기리고 튼튼한 안보와 혁신으로 더 강한 국방력을 강조하기 위해 마련한 일정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Roh Tae-ak defends 'overseas trips with spouse' by saying "That's how it's always been done" (노태악 ‘부부 해외 출장’에…“지금까지 전부 다 그렇게 해왔다고 해”)
item.description:
Former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairperson Roh Tae-ak, regarding his overseas trips with his spouse during his tenure as chairperson, said on the 23rd, "Looking at it from today's perspective, I deeply apologize for the fact that it might appear inappropriate to the public." (노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 23일 위원장 재임 당시 해외 출장을 부부 동반으로 다녀온 데 대해 “지금 관점에서 보면 국민들에게 그렇게(부적절하게) 비쳐지는 점에 대해서 대단히 송구스럽게 생각하고 있다”고 말했다.)

The former chairperson made these remarks while attending the second plenary session of the Special Committee on Parliamentary Inspection for Fact-Finding and Election Management Reform regarding the violation of the people's right to vote, such as the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections and other issues, held at the National Assembly on that day. (노 전 위원장은 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 특별위원회’(국조특위) 2차 전체회의에 출석해 이렇게 말했다.)

When Special Committee Chairperson Yoon Sang-hyun asked, "Are you willing to return funds if there was any improper use (regarding the trips with your spouse)?" Former Chairperson Roh responded, "If there was such a thing, I will find a way to return it through possible methods." (윤상현 특위위원장이 ‘(부부 동반 출장과 관련해) 부당한 자금이 있다면 반환할 용의가 있느냐’고 묻자 노 전 위원장은 “가능한 방법을 통해 그런 점이 있었으면 반환할 방법을 강구하겠다”고 답했다.)

Regarding the background of taking three overseas trips with his spouse during his tenure, Former Chairperson Roh explained, "I never requested it first," but added, "I asked (the staff) if traveling as a couple was possible, and they said it has always been done that way without any objection, so I didn't have any particular doubts." (노 전 위원장은 재임 당시 세 차례 배우자 동반으로 해외 출장을 다녀온 배경에 대해 “제가 먼저 요구한 바는 없다”면서도 “부부 동반이 가능하냐고 (실무진에 물었는데) 지금까지 전부 다, 틀림없이 그렇게 해왔고 아무런 이의제기한 바도 없어 특별히 큰 의문을 갖지 않았다”고 해명했다.)

By Jang Na-rae, reporter wing@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon, reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Targets ‘Gap’ Amid Jang Dong-hyuk’s Hospitalization… ‘Image of Efforts for Party Reentry’ Politics (장동혁 입원 ‘틈새 공략’ 나선 한동훈…‘복당 노력 이미지’ 정치)
item.description:
While Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is hospitalized for health reasons, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon are increasing their contacts with PPP lawmakers. Seizing on the ongoing negative sentiment toward Jang’s leadership, they appear to be kickstarting competition over the initiative for ‘conservative reconstruction.’ (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 건강상의 이유로 입원한 사이, 한동훈 무소속 의원과 오세훈 서울시장이 국민의힘 의원들과 접점을 늘리고 있다. 이들은 장동혁 지도부에 대한 비토 여론이 이어지는 틈을 타 ‘보수 재건’ 주도권 경쟁에 시동을 거는 모양새다.)

Lawmaker Han attended a parliamentary debate on ‘the violation of suffrage rights and electoral system reform’ held at the National Assembly on the 23rd. The event, hosted by pro-Han lawmaker Lee Seong-kwon of the PPP, saw participation from 16 PPP lawmakers, including not only pro-Han members like Park Jeong-ha and Woo Jae-joon but also lawmakers Joo Ho-young and Kim Ki-hyun. In his congratulatory remarks, Han said, “A landslide victory in the 2028 (general election) and reclaiming power in the 2030 (presidential election) are the goals of conservative reconstruction.” Mayor Oh was initially announced to attend the debate, but later only delivered his congratulatory remarks in writing. A source from Oh’s side said, “It was originally planned to only provide written greetings, but it was incorrectly reported that he would attend.” <<> Since entering the assembly, Han has been actively engaging with PPP lawmakers. He previously joined the ‘Future Innovation Forum,’ chaired by lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun, on the 16th, and had dinner on the 21st with lawmakers Jeong Seong-guk, Gwak Gyu-taek, Kim Dae-sik, and Kim Do-eup, who have constituencies in Busan. He also signed on as a co-sponsor of a bill to abolish early voting, proposed by lawmaker Park Dae-chul. However, Han’s camp is drawing a line against immediate plans to rejoin the PPP. A pro-Han lawmaker said, “Rather than trying to rejoin right away, this is to prevent any talk that ‘Han Dong-hoon didn’t make an effort to return.’” <<> Mayor Oh is scheduled to speak as a lecturer at the Future Innovation Forum’s seminar on the 24th. <<> Mayor Oh has also increased contact with PPP lawmakers, including a luncheon meeting with lawmaker Na Kyung-won, who previously served as an advisor to Seoul’s election campaign committee, and planning a dinner schedule with PPP lawmakers from the National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee and Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee. In the process of the June 3 local elections, Oh clashed with leader Jang, emphasizing, “I will surely rebuild an opposition party that acts like one and a conservative party that acts like one.” <<> Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 한 의원은 23일 국회에서 열린 ‘참정권 침해 사태와 선거제도 개혁을 위한 국회 토론회’에 참석했다. 친한(한동훈)계 이성권 국민의힘 의원이 주최한 행사에는 박정하·우재준 의원 등 친한계뿐만 아니라, 주호영·김기현 의원 등 국민의힘 의원 16명이 참석했다. 한 의원은 격려사에서 “2028년 (총선) 압승, 2030년 (대선에서) 정권을 되찾아오는 것이 보수 재건 목표”라고 말했다. 오 시장도 이날 토론회에 참석한다고 공지했다가 서면으로만 격려사를 전달했다. 오 시장 쪽은 “원래 서면 인사말만 제공한다고 했는데 참석한다고 잘못 알려졌다”고 했다. )

item.title: President Lee courts 20s and 30s amid falling approval ratings: "Youth policies to be pushed with speed" (‘지지율 하락’ 2030에 공 들이는 이 대통령…“청년 정책 속도감 있게”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung is actively working to win back the hearts of the 20s and 30s generation, as his approval ratings among them show a clear downward trend, by repeatedly delivering messages targeting them. (이재명 대통령이 지지율 하락세가 뚜렷한 2030세대를 향한 메시지를 거푸 내놓으며 청년 민심 다잡기에 나서고 있다.)

In his opening remarks at a Cabinet meeting and emergency economic review meeting held at the presidential office on the 23rd, President Lee said, "Behind the remarkable achievement of a skyrocketing stock market fueled by the semiconductor boom, a deep shadow of asset polarization looms. In particular, the younger generation, who lack opportunities to build assets through stable jobs and income, are the most marginalized," adding, "Please finalize and swiftly implement policies to expand the ladder of opportunities across all areas of young people's lives, including jobs, asset building, entrepreneurship, and housing." (이 대통령은 23일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의 머리발언에서 “반도체 호황으로 주식시장 급성장이라는 눈부신 성과의 이면에는 자산 양극화라고 하는 그늘이 짙게 드리우고 있다. 특히 안정적 일자리와 소득을 통해 자산을 형성할 기회 자체가 부족한 청년세대는 가장 큰 소외자들이다”라며 “일자리, 자산 형성, 창업, 주거 등 청년들의 삶 전 영역에서 기회의 사다리를 확대하기 위한 정책을 조속하게 확정하고 속도감 있게 추진해 달라”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "There is no single solution to resolve all the problems currently faced by this generation. If there were, we would have already done it," emphasizing, "That's why meticulous and persistent efforts to give more opportunities to young people across all policies are so important." (이 대통령은 이어 “현재 청년세대가 직면한 이런 문제들을 일거에 해소할 왕도는 없다. 그런 게 있다면 이미 다 했겠죠”라며 “정책 전반에 걸쳐 청년에게 더 많은 기회를 주기 위한 세심하고 꾸준한 노력이 그래서 중요하다”고 말했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee urged the active promotion and management of the 'Youth Future Savings Account,' for which applications began on the 22nd. This savings account is one of President Lee's key campaign promises, a financial product allowing young people aged 19 to 34 to deposit up to 500,000 won per month freely over three years. Combining interest, government contributions, and tax exemptions, the effective interest rate reaches 13.2-14.4% annually for the standard type and 18.2-19.4% for the preferential type. (그러면서 이 대통령은 지난 22일부터 신청을 받기 시작한 청년미래적금을 적극적으로 홍보하고 관리해 달라고 당부했다. 청년미래적금은 이 대통령의 핵심 공약으로 만 19~34살 청년이 월 최대 50만원까지 3년간 자유롭게 납입할 수 있는 금융상품이다. 이자·기여금·비과세 혜택을 합산하면 실질 금리가 일반형 연 13.2~14.4%, 우대형은 연 18.2~19.4%에 이른다.)

President Lee also mentioned the incident where a female firefighter in her 20s, affiliated with the Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters, made an extreme choice due to forced drinking at work. President Lee strongly criticized the incident as "the worst kind of workplace bullying," stating, "The problem is that they don't even realize it's a serious act. I hope each ministry and agency will pay special attention. Please conduct thorough internal checks." He added, "Things like trying to seat a female employee next to a senior, making her pour drinks, forcing her to attend a second round and down a glass in one shot. If someone doesn't want to drink, why force them? Drink it yourself," and stressed, "Please ensure that workplace bullying does not happen again." (이 대통령은 광주 소방안전본부 소속 20대 여성 소방관이 직장 내 음주 강요로 극단적 선택을 한 사건도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 이 사건을 “최악의 갑질”이라고 강하게 질타하며 “문제는 그게 심각한 행위인지 모른다는 것이다. 각 부처, 청에서 각별히 챙겨주면 좋겠다. 내부 조직 점검을 꼭 해보라”고 말했다. 그러면서 “여직원을 상사 옆자리에 앉히려 한다든지 여성 직원에게 술 따르게 한다든지 2차에 강제로 데려가 원샷을 시킨다든지. 술이 싫다는데 왜 원샷을 시키냐. 자기나 먹지”라며 “직장 내 갑질이 다시 나오지 않게 챙겨 달라”고 말했다.)

This is not the first time President Lee has emphasized his focus on the youth. At a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration on the 8th, regarding the ballot shortage incident at the National Election Commission, he said, "I truly have respect for the young people who pointed out the problem." Last July, following the hiring of two 'Youth Affairs Officers' at the presidential office, in April he instructed considering the creation of a youth research institute or government policy department within the presidential office. (이 대통령이 청년에 대한 관심을 강조한 것은 이번이 처음이 아니다. 이 대통령은 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “문제를 지적하는 청년들에 대해 참으로 존경할 만하다는 생각이 든다”고 말했다. 지난해 7월에는 청와대에 ‘청년담당관’ 2명을 채용한 데 이어, 4월에는 청년 연구 기관이나 정부 정책 부서를 청와대 안에 만들지 고민해보라고 지시했다.)

President Lee's efforts to court the youth are not unrelated to signs of disaffection among the 20s and 30s generation. In a survey conducted by Realmeter on behalf of the Energy Economy News from the 15th to the 19th among 2,517 eligible voters aged 18 and older nationwide (100% wireless, automated response, margin of error ±2% points at a 95% confidence level), President Lee's positive job approval rating among those in their 20s fell 6.2 percentage points from the previous week to 30.6%, and among those in their 30s, it dropped 2.4 percentage points to 34.4%. (이 대통령이 청년에 공을 들이는 것은 2030세대의 이탈 조짐과 무관하지 않다. 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 15∼19일 전국 18살 이상 유권자 2517명을 대상으로 실시한 무선(100%) 자동응답 방식의 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2%포인트)에서 20대의 이 대통령 국정수행 긍정평가는 전주보다 6.2%포인트 떨어진 30.6%였고, 30대는 2.4%포인트 하락한 34.4%였다.)

The presidential office and the government are pondering ways to gather the sentiments of the youth. Considering that the youth employment rate has been declining for 25 consecutive months, government ministries are preparing 'youth job recovery plans,' including expanding public sector hiring. A presidential official stated, "We are considering institutional mechanisms or bodies that can collect the voices of young people." (청와대와 정부는 청년 민심 수렴 방안을 고심하고 있다. 정부 부처에서는 청년 고용률이 25개월 연속 감소세를 보이는 상황을 고려해 공공부문 채용 확대 등 ‘청년 일자리 회복 방안’을 마련하고 있다. 청와대 관계자는 “청년들의 목소리를 수렴할 수 있는 제도적 장치나 기구 등에 대해 고민하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Song Young-gil warms up, may join hands with Kim Min-seok… possibility of an alliance to 'check Chung Cheong-rae' (몸 푸는 송영길, 김민석과 손 잡나…‘정청래 견제’ 연대 가능성)
item.description:
It was confirmed on the 23rd that Song Young-gil, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, recently had an unofficial dinner with President Lee Jae-myung. Amid Song's escalating offensive against Representative Chung Cheong-rae, who is widely expected to seek re-election, there are predictions within the party that Song might run in the party convention, about 50 days away, forming a 'Song Young-gil-Kim Min-seok' united front to stand against Representative Chung. (송영길 더불어민주당 의원이 최근 이재명 대통령과 비공식 만찬을 한 것으로 23일 확인됐다. 송 의원이 최근 연임 도전이 확실시되는 정청래 대표를 향한 공세 수위를 높이는 가운데, 당내에서는 50여일 앞으로 다가온 전당대회에 송 의원이 출마해 정 대표와 맞서는 ‘송영길-김민석’ 연합 전선이 꾸려질 수 있다는 전망이 나온다.)

A ruling party source said that on the 18th, the day President Lee returned from his European tour, including attending the G7 summit, Song had a private dinner with him at the presidential residence in Hannam-dong, Yongsan-gu, Seoul. The source told The Hankyoreh, "I understand they had a wide-ranging discussion on current political issues." A source close to Song also said, "The two have a long-standing camaraderie, so meeting at any time is not particularly unusual." Song has a connection with Lee, having given up his parliamentary seat to run in the 2022 Seoul mayoral election, thereby passing on his constituency of Gyeyang-gu in Incheon, where he had served five terms, to then-candidate Lee Jae-myung. (송 의원은 이 대통령이 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 등 유럽 순방을 마치고 귀국한 당일인 지난 18일 서울 용산구 한남동 대통령 관저에서 이 대통령과 비공개로 저녁 식사를 했다고 여권 관계자가 밝혔다. 이 관계자는 한겨레에 “정국 현안에 대해 폭넓게 이야기한 것으로 안다”고 했다. 송 의원 쪽 관계자도 “두분이 오랜 동지적 관계인 만큼 언제 만나더라도 특별한 일은 아니”라고 했다. 송 의원은 2022년 서울시장 선거 출마를 위해 의원직을 내려놓으면서 자신이 5선을 지낸 인천 계양을 지역구를 이재명 당시 후보에게 이어준 인연이 있다.)

Both inside and outside the Democratic Party, various interpretations are emerging in conjunction with the possibility of Song running in the party convention. With Representative Chung and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok likely to run for party leadership, if Song joins, creating a three-way race, it could form a 'united front' against Representative Chung. On the 21st, Song told KBC Gwangju Broadcasting, "Is the ruling party's leader now opposing the president?" He left the door open, saying, "Whether I run in the party convention will depend on what decision Representative Chung makes." (민주당 안팎에서는 송 의원의 전당대회 출마 가능성과 맞물려 다양한 해석이 나오고 있다. 정 대표와 김민석 국무총리의 당 대표 선거 출마가 유력한 상황에서 송 의원까지 가세해 3파전이 펼쳐지게 된다면, 정 대표에 맞서는 ‘연합 전선’이 만들어질 수 있다는 것이다. 송 의원은 지난 21일 케이비시(KBC)광주방송에서 “집권당의 대표가 지금 대통령과 맞서자는 것인가”라며 “(전당대회 출마 여부는) 정 대표가 어떤 결정을 할지 지켜보겠다”고 가능성을 열어뒀다.)

A lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, "Since Prime Minister Kim is still in office and cannot take the lead, Song could play the role of attacking Representative Chung. If Prime Minister Kim fully enters the party leadership race, a cooperative structure might be possible." There are also prospects that support from party members, which is advantageous for Representative Chung, might be diverted toward Song, potentially creating a runoff election scenario. According to the party's constitution and rules, if three or more candidates run for party leader and no one secures a majority in the first round of voting, a runoff is held between the top two candidates. (한 수도권 의원은 이에 대해 “김 총리가 아직 총리직을 유지하고 있어 전면에 나서기 어려운 만큼, 송 의원이 정 대표를 향해 공세하는 역할을 할 수 있다”며 “김 총리가 당권 경쟁에 본격적으로 뛰어들면 연대하는 구도가 가능하지 않겠느냐”고 말했다. 정 대표에게 유리한 권리당원의 지지세를 송 의원 쪽으로 분산시켜, 결선투표 구도를 만들 수 있다는 전망도 나온다. 민주당 당헌·당규에 따르면 당 대표 선거에 3명 이상이 출마해 1차 경선에서 과반 득표자가 나오지 않을 경우, 최다 득표자 2명을 대상으로 결선투표를 한다. )

A two-term lawmaker said, "There is a consensus on the need to check Representative Chung, but individual political goals may differ, so we need to see if the alliance will last to the end." Lawmaker Kim Young-ho, close to Song, appeared on SBS Radio and said, "It seems he will run. He seems to be warming up gradually." Song, who is currently visiting the United States, plans to return to Korea on the 27th after meeting with House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries. (한 재선 의원은 “정 대표를 견제해야 한다는 점에서 공감대를 이루지만 개별적인 정치적 지향점은 다를 수 있기 때문에 연대가 끝까지 이어질지는 지켜봐야 한다”고 했다. 송 의원과 가까운 김영호 의원은 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오에 출연해 “(선거에) 나올 것 같다. 슬슬 몸을 푸는 것 같다”고 했다. 미국을 방문 중인 송 의원은 민주당 하원 원내대표 하킴 제프리스 등을 만난 뒤 오는 27일 귀국한다.)

Meanwhile, Representative Chung attended an event at the Kim Dae-jung Nobel Peace Prize Memorial Hall in Mokpo, South Jeolla Province on this day. Following visits to North and South Jeolla on the 19th and 20th, he returned to the region after three days, courting the sentiments of Honam party members. Representative Chung is expected to announce his position either at the Supreme Council meeting on the 24th or following the formation of the party convention preparatory committee on the 26th. Prime Minister Kim, who traveled to China on the 22nd to attend the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF), will return to Korea on the 24th. (한편 정 대표는 이날 전남 목포 김대중 노벨평화상 기념관 행사에 참석했다. 지난 19~20일 전북·전남을 찾은 데 이어 사흘 만에 다시 이 지역을 찾아 호남 당심에 구애하는 모습이다. 정 대표는 24일 최고위원회의나 26일 전당대회준비위원회 구성을 계기로 거취를 표명할 것으로 보인다. 하계 세계경제포럼(WEF) 연례회의 참석차 지난 22일 중국 출장을 간 김 총리는 24일 귀국한다.)

item.title: 'Fighting the December 12 Rebellion' Lt. Col. Kim Oh-rang and Petty Officer Jeong Seon-yeop Awarded Combat Merit Medal (‘12·12 반란 맞서 전사’ 김오랑 중령·정선엽 하사, 무공훈장 수여)
item.description:
The government decided at a Cabinet meeting on the 23rd to posthumously award the Chungmu Combat Merit Medal to the late Lt. Col. Kim Oh-rang and the late Petty Officer Jeong Seon-yeop, who were killed fighting against rebel forces during the December 12 military rebellion in 1979. (정부는 23일 국무회의에서 1979년 12·12 군사반란 당시 반란군에 맞서 싸우다 전사한 고 김오랑 중령과 고 정선엽 하사에게 충무무공훈장 추서를 결정했다.)

The government had considered posthumously awarding a combat merit medal to Lt. Col. Kim, but due to legal restrictions under the Decoration Act that prohibit duplicate awards, the existing National Security Medal previously granted to Kim was revoked in March, followed by the new posthumous award of the Chungmu Combat Merit Medal on this day. The National Security Medal is awarded for non-combat contributions, while the Combat Merit Medal recognizes achievements in battle. Lt. Col. Kim, who served as chief of staff to Special Warfare Commander General Jeong Byeong-ju during the December 12 coup in 1979, died in a gunfight with rebel forces who stormed the commander's office to arrest General Jeong. (정부는 김 중령에게 무공훈장 추서를 검토하였으나, 상훈법상 ‘중복 수여의 금지’에 따라 훈장을 거듭 수여할 수 없는 법적 제약이 있어, 지난 3월 기존에 수여된 김 중령의 보국훈장을 취소한 데 이어 이날 충무무공훈장을 새로 추서했다. 보국훈장은 전투 이외 공적을, 무공훈장은 전투 중 세운 공적을 대상으로 하는 훈장이다. 1979년 12·12 쿠데타 당시 정병주 특전사령관의 비서실장이었던 김 중령은 정 사령관을 체포하러 사령관실에 들이닥친 반란군과 총격전을 벌이다 숨졌다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Justifies "Expanding and Strengthening Nuclear Forces" by Citing South Korea's Nuclear Submarine Plans (김정은, 한국 핵잠 추진 거론하며 “핵무력 확대·강화” 정당화)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un has justified the strengthening of nuclear capabilities and military forces, claiming that South Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines and the operation of the Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG), a South Korea-U.S. extended deterrence consultative body, are driving the Korean Peninsula into a nuclear war crisis. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 한국의 핵추진잠수함 보유 추진과 한-미 확장억제 협의체인 핵협의그룹(NCG) 가동이 한반도를 핵전쟁의 위기로 내몰고 있다며 핵 능력과 군사력 강화를 정당화했다.)

According to a report by the Rodong Sinmun on the 23rd, Kim stated at the conclusion of the 2nd Enlarged Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, held from the 20th to the 22nd, that "the United States and South Korea are increasingly blatant in their moves to augment and modernize forces in the region, even pushing to possess South Korean nuclear submarines." He added, "What is more dangerous is that the U.S. and South Korea have again opened a military simulation theater of the Nuclear Consultative Group, a nuclear war mechanism aimed at attacking our republic, by incorporating nuclear elements such as a nuclear-conventional integrated posture." Kim also claimed regarding the six rounds of South Korea-U.S. NCG discussions held up until the 9th that "a nuclear war script has been drawn up" and that "this is pushing the situation on the Korean Peninsula to the brink of nuclear war." <<> Kim then stated, "Continuously expanding and strengthening nuclear forces and thoroughly exercising the status of a nuclear weapons state is the most correct and only path." This reveals North Korea's perception that its expansion of nuclear forces is a legitimate response to the South Korea-U.S. buildup of nuclear armaments. Kim referred to South Korea as "the most hostile state" and said, "We must thoroughly adhere to the principle of struggle against the enemy." This reaffirms the relationship of "hostile two states." <<> Kim mentioned major defense projects, including the construction of a 10,000-ton strategic missile cruiser decided by the Party Central Military Commission in April, fortification of the southern border, and building naval bases, portraying these military force enhancements as a "proportional response" to South Korea's military buildup. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, told The Hankyoreh, "This enlarged meeting seems to be the first time Kim directly mentioned the South Korea-U.S. nuclear submarines or the NCG. With (South Korea-U.S.) cooperation becoming more visible, Kim’s mention at this meeting, which included key military commanders, appears aimed at strengthening the justification for nuclear force augmentation and signaling the intention to prepare deterrence measures." A foreign ministry official said to reporters on the same day, "The South Korea-U.S. extended deterrence cooperation aligns with the international nonproliferation regime, and our development of nuclear submarines is a response to the advancement of North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities and other security conditions on the Korean Peninsula." <<> Meanwhile, at this enlarged meeting, Jo Yong-won, considered the second-in-command in the Kim Jong-un regime and a "doorkeeper power," moved from his post as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly to become a Central Committee Secretary and head of the Organization and Guidance Department. This unusual personnel change, occurring just three months after he became the head of the Supreme People's Assembly, is interpreted as an attempt to bolster Kim's control. It may also be aimed at addressing corruption issues that have emerged within the military. Chang Yong-seok, a visiting research fellow at Seoul National University's Institute for Peace and Unification Studies, said, "The organization secretary plays a role in organizational control. Kim sending a close aide like Jo Yong-won indicates he needed a figure capable of playing a role across state affairs generally." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (김 위원장은 지난 20∼22일 열린 노동당 중앙위원회 제9기 제2차 전원회의 확대회의 결론에서 “미국과 한국은 지역 내 무력증강 및 현대화 책동을 날로 로(노)골화하면서 한국의 핵잠수함 보유까지 추진하고 있다”며 “보다 위험한 것은 미·한이 핵·재래식 통합 태세 등 핵요소를 동반하여 우리 공화국을 공격하기 위한 핵전쟁 기구인 핵협의그룹의 군사적 모의판을 또다시 벌려놓은 것”이라고 말했다고 노동신문이 23일 보도했다. 김 위원장은 지난 9일까지 모두 6차례 열린 한-미 핵협의그룹 논의에 대해서는 “핵전쟁 각본이 작성됐다”며 “조선반도 정세를 핵전쟁의 문어구(문어귀)로 떠밀고 있다”고 주장했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Amid Growth in Semiconductors and Stocks, Asset Polarization... Young People's Sense of Alienation Is Heartbreaking" (이 대통령 “반도체·주식 성장 속 자산 양극화…청년 소외감 뼈아파”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 23rd, "While there are achievements such as the semiconductor boom and the rapid growth of stocks, a shadow of asset polarization looms large on the other side," and urged cabinet members to consider policies across the board to prevent young people from losing opportunities due to polarization. (이재명 대통령이 23일 “반도체 호황과 주식 급성장이라는 성과가 있지만, 그 이면에는 자산 양극화라는 그늘이 짙게 드리우고 있다”며 청년들이 양극화로 인해 기회를 잃지 않도록 정책 전반에 걸쳐 고민해달라고 국무위원들에게 주문했다.)

At a cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "The government must painfully acknowledge the sense of alienation among young people, who feel that 'record-breaking bonuses or the KOSPI are stories from a different world for me.'" He added, "Young people who lack the opportunity to build assets through stable jobs and income are the most marginalized in today's era." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 연 국무회의에서 “역대급 성과급이나 코스피에도 ‘나에겐 다른 세상 이야기’라는 (청년들의) 소외감을 정부가 뼈아프게 받아들여야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “안정적 일자리와 소득을 통해 자산을 형성할 기회 자체가 부족한 청년들은 현시대의 가장 큰 소외자들”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission, which has been embroiled in controversy over poor election management, President Lee said, "It is an independent agency established by the Constitution, making it impossible to control," and ordered an increase in investigative personnel from the joint police-prosecution investigation team probing the commission, expanding the scope of the probe to include hiring irregularities, corruption, and budget misuse. (또 부실 선거 관리로 논란에 휩싸인 선거관리위원회에 대해서는 “헌법이 정한 독립기관이라 통제가 불가능하다”며 선관위를 수사하는 검경 합동수사본부 수사인력을 늘리고 채용 비리와 부정부패, 예산 남용까지 수사 범위를 확대하라고 지시했다.)

President Lee also addressed the government-introduced maximum oil price system, aimed at preventing a sharp rise in oil prices due to the Middle Eastern war, saying, "We should boldly maintain it and even lower the maximum price further." He also instructed officials to research measures to support low-income households amid income polarization. (이 대통령은 중동 전쟁으로 인한 유가 급등 상황을 막고자 정부가 도입한 석유 최고가격제와 관련해 “과감하게 더 유지하고, 최고가격도 좀 낮춰야 할 거 같다”고 말했다. 아울러 소득 양극화로 인한 서민 소득지원 방안도 연구하라고 지시했다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: NEC Secretariat: “May Constitute Grounds for Re-Election”…Reported in Early Morning Meeting on June 4 (선관위 사무처 “재투표 사유 해당할 수도”…6월4일 새벽 회의서 보고)
item.description:
It has been learned that during a meeting of the National Election Commission (NEC) in the early hours of June 4, the day after the June 3 local elections, the secretariat reported a legal interpretation stating that the shortage of ballot papers “may constitute grounds for a re-election.” (6·3 지방선거 다음날인 4일 새벽 중앙선거관리위원회 회의에서 사무처가 투표용지 부족사태에 관해 “재투표 사유에 해당할 수도 있다”는 법리 해석을 보고한 것으로 파악됐다.)

According to annexes of the meeting minutes submitted to the office of Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Nam-hee on the 23rd, the secretariat reported on “a summary regarding whether the shortage of ballot papers constitutes grounds for postponing the election” at the meeting that began at 12:38 a.m. on the 4th. (23일 김남희 더불어민주당 의원실이 중앙선관위로부터 제출받은 회의록 부속서류를 보면 사무처 해석과는 4일 오전 0시38분 시작한 회의에서 ‘투표용지 부족에 따른 선거연기 사유 해당 여부 등 정리’를 보고했다.)

The secretariat’s interpretation department reported that “since there are voters who were unable to vote due to the ballot paper shortage, it can be seen as falling under ‘other unavoidable reasons’ (under Article 198, Paragraph 1 of the Public Official Election Act).” Article 198, Paragraph 1 of the Public Official Election Act stipulates that grounds for a re-election include “cases where voting in any polling district cannot be conducted due to natural disasters, other unavoidable reasons, or loss or destruction of ballot boxes.” (사무처 해석과는 “투표용지 부족으로 투표를 하지 못한 선거인이 있으므로 (공직선거법 198조 1항의) ‘기타 부득이한 사유’에 해당한다고 볼 수도 있다”라고 보고했다. 공직선거법 198조 1항은 재투표 사유에 대해 ‘천재·지변 기타 부득이한 사유로 인해 어느 투표구의 투표를 실시하지 못한 때와 투표함의 분실·멸실 등의 사유가 발생한 때’라고 규정하고 있다. )

The interpretation department cited this provision along with a 1960 Supreme Court precedent, which held that “‘cases where voting in any polling district cannot be conducted’ includes cases where some voters are unable to vote.” It also reported that “if it is deemed unlikely to affect the election result in the relevant electoral district, the winner can be determined without holding a re-election; however, such a judgment requires the completion of the vote-counting process.” In other words, if the difference in votes between the winner and the loser is greater than the difference between the total number of voters in the polling district and the number of voters who actually voted, it can be considered unlikely to affect the election result. It also stated that the decision on whether to hold a re-election rests with the relevant electoral district election commission. (해석과는 이 규정과 함께 1960년 대법원 판례(‘어느 투표구의 투표를 실시하지 못한 때’는 일부의 투표권자가 투표를 행하지 못한 경우를 포함)를 함께 근거로 들었다. 또 해석과는 “재투표가 당해 선거구의 선거결과에 영향을 미칠 염려가 없다고 인정되는 때에는 재투표를 실시하지 아니하고 당선인을 결정할 수 있으나, 이와 같은 판단을 위해서는 개표절차 종료가 필요하다”고 보고했다. 당선인과 낙선인 간의 득표수 차이가 투표구 전체 선거인 수에서 투표한 선거인 수의 차이보다 클 경우에는 선거구의 선거결과에 영향을 미칠 염려가 없다고 볼 수 있다는 것이다. 또 재투표 여부 결정 주체는 관할 선거구 선관위라고도 했다. )

Additionally, the interpretation department clarified that there were no grounds for postponing the election or for a by-election, and that there were no legal provisions for stopping vote counting or invalidating the election. Unlike a by-election (Article 195 of the Public Official Election Act), which starts the entire process anew from candidate registration, a re-election (Article 198 of the Public Official Election Act) involves holding a new vote only in the specific affected polling district and then adding the results to the existing totals. (아울러 해석과는 선거연기 사유, 재선거 사유에는 해당하지 않고 개표중단, 선거무효 결정은 근거 규정이 없다고 밝혔다. 후보 등록부터 절차 전체를 새롭게 하는 재선거(공직선거법 195조)와 달리, 재투표(공직선거법 198조)는 문제가 된 특정 선거구 투표만 다시 해 기존 결과에 합산하게 돼있다.)

At the time, the NEC issued a statement saying that “it does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or a by-election under the Public Official Election Act,” and that “it is impossible to stop the ongoing vote counting.” However, it did not mention a re-election. (당시 선관위는 입장문을 내고 “공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”면서 “현재 진행되는 개표를 중단하는 것은 불가하다”라고 밝혔다. 하지만 재투표에 대해 언급하지는 않았다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ballot Paper Ignites Power Game... 'By-Election Civil War' in People Power Party, 'Jeong Cheong-rae's Fate' in Democratic Party [Gongdeok Pocha] (투표용지가 불붙인 권력 게임…국힘 ‘재선거 내전’·민주 ‘정청래 거취’ [공덕포차])
item.description:
Concerns are emerging within the ruling party over the appointments of new Presidential Civil Affairs Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik and Judicial System Secretary Park Ji-young. (한찬식 신임 청와대 민정수석과 박지영 사법제도비서관 인선을 둘러싸고 여당 안에서 우려의 목소리가 나오고 있습니다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong stated in a CBS radio interview on the 23rd that the appointment of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik prioritized not only the will and ability for prosecution reform but also a thorough understanding of the internal organization of the prosecution. The intent is that a high level of understanding of the prosecution—the target of reform—would actually facilitate the smooth completion of prosecution reform. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 23일 CBS 라디오 인터뷰에서 한찬식 수석 임명 배경에 대해 검찰 개혁 의지와 능력뿐 아니라 검찰 내부 조직에 대한 파악 정도를 중요하게 봤다고 밝혔습니다. 개혁 대상인 검찰 조직에 대한 이해도가 높아야 오히려 검찰 개혁을 순조롭게 마무리할 수 있다는 취지입니다.)

Nevertheless, within the ruling party's support base, a so-called 'indictment withdrawal deal theory' has emerged, suggesting that the appointment of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik is an attempt to secure an indictment withdrawal at the cost of maintaining the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. Rep. Ko Min-jung, a former spokesperson for the Moon Jae-in administration, criticized on Facebook that Senior Secretary Han, as a prosecutor during the Moon administration, had judged the personnel of that administration as criminal. Gyeonggi Province Governor-elect Choo Mi-ae also expressed a sense of emptiness on Facebook, quoting Jeong Ho-seung's poem 'Shattered to Pieces'. (그럼에도 여당 지지층 내부에서는 한찬식 수석 임명을 통해 검찰의 보완수사권 유지를 대가로 공소취소를 얻어내려는 것 아니냐는 이른바 ‘공소취소 거래설’까지 나오고 있습니다. 문재인 정부 청와대 대변인을 지낸 고민정 의원은 페이스북에 한 수석이 문재인 정부 당시 검사로서 문재인 정부 인사를 범죄로 판단했던 사람이라고 비판했습니다. 추미애 경기도지사 당선인 역시 페이스북에 정호승의 시 ‘산산조각’을 인용하며 허탈함을 토로했습니다.)

Opposition is also mounting over the position of Judicial System Secretary, to which prosecutor-turned-lawyer Park Ji-young was appointed. Since the Judicial System Secretary is a role primarily responsible for prosecution and judicial reform, the core of the controversy lies in the fact that key posts essential for leading prosecution reform have been successively filled with individuals from a prosecution background. (검찰 출신 박지영 변호사가 임명된 사법제도비서관 자리를 두고도 반발이 이어지고 있습니다. 사법제도비서관은 검찰·사법개혁 등을 주무로 하는 자리인 만큼, 검찰개혁을 실질적으로 이끌어야 할 핵심 요직을 연이어 검찰 출신 인사로 채웠다는 점이 논란의 핵심입니다.)

Is this appointment, which fills the key posts responsible for prosecution reform one after another with former prosecutors, a strategic move to finalize reform, or a signal that dulls the momentum for change? Additionally, a recent poll showed positive evaluations, which had consistently maintained a lead since the president's inauguration, falling behind negative evaluations for the first time. What is the reason for this approval rating dead cross? We investigate on 'Gongdeok Pocha'. Check out the video! (검찰개혁을 책임질 핵심 요직을 연이어 검찰 출신으로 채운 이번 인선은, 과연 개혁의 마무리를 위한 포석일까요, 아니면 개혁 동력을 무디게 만드는 신호일까요? 또 대통령 취임 후 줄곧 우위를 지켜온 긍정평가가 처음으로 부정평가에 자리를 내준 여론조사가 나왔는데, 이 지지율 데드크로스의 이유는 무엇일까요? '공덕포차'에서 알아봅니다. 영상으로 확인하시죠!)

item.title: President Lee Hosts Dinner for Diplomatic Corps in Seoul... 118 Nations Gather for Grilled Pork Belly and Chicken and Beer (이 대통령, 주한외교단 초청 만찬…118개국 모여 솥뚜껑삼겹살·치맥)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung invited the diplomatic corps in South Korea to a dinner at the presidential garden of Cheong Wa Dae on the 23rd, sharing diplomatic achievements. (이재명 대통령이 23일 청와대 녹지원으로 주한 외교 사절단을 초청해 만찬을 함께하고 외교 성과를 공유했다.)

In his remarks, President Lee stated, "The Republic of Korea has participated in the G7 summit for two consecutive years and is establishing itself as a responsible partner in the international community," adding, "We will continue to closely cooperate with the international community based on the common values of humanity: freedom, peace, and prosperity." He further encouraged the attendees, saying, "The active summit diplomacy was possible because you faithfully served as a bridge connecting your home countries and South Korea." (이 대통령은 “대한민국은 2년 연속 주요7개국(G7) 정상회의에 참석했고, 국제사회의 책임 있는 파트너로 자리매김하고 있다”며 “앞으로도 자유와 평화, 번영이라는 인류 공동의 가치를 바탕으로 국제사회와 긴밀하게 협력하겠다”고 인사말을 통해 밝혔다. 이어 “활발한 정상 외교를 할 수 있었던 것은 여러분이 본국과 대한민국을 잇는 가교 역할을 충실히 해주셨기 때문”이라고 격려했다.)

President Lee also expressed his willingness to listen to the attendees' opinions, saying, "You likely have much to say to the South Korean government, and there might be things you want to directly tell the presidential office. Incidentally, I have plenty of free time." He also suggested, "I will shout out 'cheers' in Korean, and I ask you to do the same in your respective languages." (이 대통령은 “대한민국 정부에 하고 싶은 얘기가 상당히 많을 것이고, 대통령실에 직접 말씀하고 싶은 것도 있을 것이다. 참고로 의외로 제가 시간이 많이 남는다”면서 참석자들의 의견을 경청하겠다는 뜻을 드러냈다. 또 “저는 대한민국 말로 ‘건배’를 외칠 테니 각국의 언어로 건배를 해달라”고 제안하기도 했다.)

The dinner was attended by the dean of the diplomatic corps, Moroccan Ambassador to South Korea Shafik Rachadi, along with ambassadors from all 118 resident embassies and representatives from 30 international organizations. The head table was shared by ambassadors from Morocco, as well as the United States, Japan, the Philippines, New Zealand, Mongolia, China, the European Union (EU), the Holy See, and Chile. Cheong Wa Dae explained that the seating arrangement was made considering the major summit diplomatic visits and receptions this year, as well as regional representation. (이날 만찬에는 주한 외교단장인 샤픽 라샤디 주한 모로코 대사를 비롯해 전체 118국 상주 공관 대사와 30개 국제기구 대표들이 참석했다. 주빈석에는 모로코와 함께 미국, 일본, 필리핀, 뉴질랜드, 몽골, 중국, 유럽연합(EU), 교황청, 칠레 대사 등이 자리했다. 청와대는 올해 주요 정상외교 방문·접수 국가 및 지역 대표성 등을 고려해 안배한 것이라고 설명했다.)

The dinner menu was served buffet-style, featuring Korean-style charcoal-grilled dishes, "chimaek" (chicken and beer), Korean-style geotjeori (fresh kimchi), and ssambap (rice wraps), with draft beer available. In addition to chicken, the menu included a variety of items such as grilled pork belly cooked on a cauldron lid, charcoal-grilled wagyu beef and LA-style marinated short ribs, lamb ribs, king prawns, chicken sausages, and vegetables. All ingredients except for pork belly were halal-certified. Vegan and other vegetarian options were also prepared. (만찬 메뉴로는 한국식 숯불구이와 ‘치맥’, 한국식 겉절이와 쌈밥 등이 뷔페 형식으로 제공됐고 생맥주를 곁들일 수 있도록 했다. 치킨 외에도 솥뚜껑 삼겹살 구이, 숯불에 구운 쇠고기 와규 및 엘에이(LA) 양념갈비, 양갈비, 왕새우, 치킨 소시지, 채소 등 다양한 메뉴가 제공됐다. 삼겹살을 제외한 모든 식재료는 할랄 인증 제품을 사용했다. 비건 등 채식주의자를 위한 메뉴도 마련했다.)

By Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Noh Tae-ak “Non-standing Election Commission System No Longer Viable”…Wi Cheol-hwan “Constitutional Amendment If Necessary” (노태악 “선관위 비상임체제 더는 불가”…위철환 “필요땐 개헌해야”)
item.description:
On the 23rd, the ruling and opposition parties held a plenary session of the “Special Committee on Parliamentary Investigation for Fact-Finding on Violations of Citizens’ Right to Vote, Including the Ballot Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and Election Management Reform” (Election Commission Special Investigation Committee). They criticized former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairperson Noh Tae-ak for the mismanagement of the June 3 local elections and for taking spousal business trips during his tenure. Acting NEC Chairperson Wi Cheol-hwan and former Chairperson Noh stated, “We believe a constitutional amendment should be pursued if necessary,” highlighting the need for a “single-point constitutional amendment.” <<> Acting Chairperson Wi attended the second plenary session of the Election Commission parliamentary investigation at the National Assembly that day. In response to a question from Special Committee Chairperson Yoon Sang-hyun, who asked, “Do you view this incident as more structural than personal, and is that why you proposed introducing a standing chairperson system?” Wi answered, “Yes.” When asked by Jeong Choon-saeng, a lawmaker from the Fatherland Innovation Party, “The Election Commission has reached a point where it cannot avoid audits,” Wi replied, “I believe a single-point constitutional amendment might be necessary.” Former Chairperson Noh also said, “If a constitutional amendment is needed, it should be done.” Wi stated, “The chairperson needs to be a full-time role to take control of the secretariat’s functions. Placing a single standing commissioner in the middle wouldn’t effectively work, as they only hold one-ninth of the voting power. We acknowledge our lack of insight and incompetence. Trusting the secretariat too much was also a contributing factor.” <<> In response to a query from Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Hae-sik, who asked, “Do you believe the non-standing chairperson system should continue?” former Chairperson Noh replied, “I think it is no longer viable.” The system, in place since the NEC’s establishment in 1963, where a Supreme Court justice serves as a part-time chairperson, has been identified as a key cause of internal management failures. Noh bowed his head and said, “As chairperson, I deeply feel responsible for the committee’s failure to manage things thoroughly.” Noh resigned on the 5th, taking responsibility for the incident. <<> During the meeting, former Chairperson Noh’s “spousal business trips” also came under scrutiny. During his tenure, Noh took three overseas trips to Australia, New Zealand, and other locations, accompanied by his spouse. The airfare and accommodation costs for his spouse were all covered by taxpayer money. Noh said, “Looking back from today’s perspective, I deeply regret that this appeared inappropriate to the public.” When Chairperson Yoon asked, “If any funds were improperly used regarding the spousal trips, are you willing to return them?” Noh replied, “I will explore ways to return them if such issues exist, through possible means.” <<> At the start of the meeting, key witnesses, including seven non-standing NEC commissioners, did not appear, prompting both ruling and opposition parties to unanimously denounce it as “a collective defiance against the public.” Five of the seven non-standing commissioners hurriedly attended the afternoon session. Min So-young, former chairperson of the Songpa District Election Commission (Senior Presiding Judge of the Seoul Eastern District Court), who attended in the afternoon, stated in response to questions about the Songpa District Election Commission, “I currently have no knowledge of how the ballots were actually distributed to polling stations, so I cannot provide specific answers.” <<> President Lee Jae-myung, presiding over a Cabinet meeting at the presidential office that day, ordered an increase in personnel from the joint prosecution and police investigation headquarters to probe not only the ballot shortage but also other issues at the NEC, such as budget waste and hiring irregularities. President Lee said, “There has been a lack of internal awareness and lax management. We must thoroughly and formally uncover all problematic aspects and hold people accountable.” <<> Reported by Yoo Young-jae and Kim Chae-woon young@hani.co.kr (여야는 23일 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 특별위원회’(선관위 국조특위) 전체회의를 열고, 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장의 6·3 지방선거 관리 부실 책임, 재임 기간 부부 동반 출장에 대한 비판을 쏟아냈다. 위철환 중앙선거관리위원장 직무대행과 노 전 위원장은 “개헌도 필요하다면 해야 한다는 생각은 있다”며 ‘원포인트 개헌’ 필요성을 언급했다.)

item.title: From Wartime Operational Control to 'Conditions-Based Transition' – President Rhee's Letter (전작권, 이승만 대통령 편지에서 ‘조건에 기초한 전환’까지)
item.description:
The origins of the controversy surrounding the operational control (OPCON) of South Korean forces date back to the Korean War in 1950. (한국군의 작전통제권을 둘러싼 논란의 시작은 1950년 한국전쟁 때로 거슬러 올라간다.)

On July 14, 1950, President Syngman Rhee sent a letter to General Douglas MacArthur, commander of the United Nations Command (UNC), proposing the transfer of "command authority (now operational control) over the South Korean Army, Navy, and Air Force." General MacArthur accepted this in a reply on July 18, thereby transferring OPCON to the UNC. ( 1950년 7월14일 이승만 대통령은 더글러스 맥아더 유엔군사령관에게 편지를 보내 “한국 육군, 해군, 공군에 대한 지휘권(현 작전통제권)”을 이양할 것을 제안했다. 맥아더 사령관이 7월18일 답신에서 이를 수락하면서 작전권은 유엔군사령부(유엔사)로 넘어갔다.)

Shortly after the Korean War, in November 1954, South Korea and the United States stipulated in a bilateral agreed minutes that "as long as the UNC is responsible for the defense of the Republic of Korea, its forces shall be placed under the operational control of the UNC." ( 한·미는 한국전쟁 직후인 1954년 11월 체결한 한-미 합의의사록에서 “유엔사가 대한민국의 방위를 책임지는 한 그 군대를 유엔사의 작전통제권하에 둔다”고 규정했다. )

There were some changes to the OPCON exercised by the UNC in the 1960s. In September 1965, South Korea and the U.S. agreed that South Korean combat troops deployed to Vietnam would be released from UNC operational control and placed under South Korean command. Following the January 21 incident in 1968, when North Korean special forces attempted to raid the Blue House, South Korea's operational control over counter-infiltration operations was recognized in April of that year. (유엔사가 행사하던 작전권은 1960년대 일부 변화가 있었다. 한국과 미국은 1965년 9월 베트남에 파병된 한국군 전투병력은 유엔사 작전통제를 풀어 한국이 지휘하도록 했다. 1968년 북한군 특수부대가 청와대를 습격한 1·21사태 뒤에는 같은 해 4월 대간첩작전에 대한 한국의 작전통제권이 인정됐다.)

As national power grew and the Cold War eased in the late 1980s, South Korea's efforts to regain wartime operational control (Wartime OPCON) gained momentum. ( 1980년대 후반 들어 국력이 커지고 냉전이 누그러지자 한국의 전작권 환수 노력은 본격화했다.)

During the 1987 presidential election, candidate Roh Tae-woo of the Democratic Justice Party announced a pledge to "reclaim operational control." The Kim Young-sam administration regained only peacetime operational control in December 1994, citing the first North Korean nuclear crisis. In February 2007, the Roh Moo-hyun administration agreed with the U.S. to transfer Wartime OPCON to South Korea effective April 17, 2012. The date April 17 was chosen by reversing the date July 14, when former President Rhee had transferred OPCON. ( 1987년 대선 당시 노태우 민주정의당 후보는 “작전통제권을 환수하겠다”는 공약을 발표했고, 김영삼 정부는 1994년 12월 1차 북핵 위기 등을 이유로 평시작전통제권만 넘겨받았다. 노무현 정부는 2007년 2월 “2012년 4월17일부로 전시작전통제권(전작권)을 한국으로 이양한다”고 미국과 합의했다. 4월17일은 이승만 전 대통령이 전작권을 이양한 날짜인 7월14일을 거꾸로 한 택일이었다.)

However, the Lee Myung-bak administration postponed the transfer to December 1, 2015, citing unstable security conditions such as North Korea's second nuclear test (2009). The subsequent Park Geun-hye administration further delayed the transfer in April 2014, citing North Korea's third nuclear test. In particular, they agreed not to set a specific transfer date but to carry out the transition when mutually agreed conditions are met. The Moon Jae-in administration emphasized a "swift transfer of Wartime OPCON," but it did not materialize. Former President Yoon Suk Yeol showed little interest in reclaiming Wartime OPCON. (그러나 이명박 정부는 2010년 6월 북한의 2차 핵실험(2009년) 등 불안한 안보 상황을 들어 환수 시기를 2015년 12월1일로 늦췄고 이어 들어선 박근혜 정부는 2014년 4월 북한의 3차 핵실험 등을 이유로 환수를 연기했다. 특히 전작권 환수 시기를 특정하지 않고 양국이 상호 합의한 전환조건이 충족되는 시기에 전작권을 전환하기로 합의했다. 문재인 정부는 ‘조속한 전작권 전환’을 강조했지만 이뤄지지 않았다. 윤석열 전 대통령은 전작권 환수에 관심이 없었다.)

Amid these twists and turns, South Korea and the U.S. completed the first stage—Initial Operational Capability (IOC) assessment and verification for the future combined command that will replace the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command after the Wartime OPCON transfer—in 2019 and 2020, respectively. The second stage, Full Operational Capability (FOC) assessment, was completed in 2022, and verification is planned for the 58th ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting this fall. After completing the third stage—Full Mission Capability (FMC) assessment and verification—the defense ministers of South Korea and the U.S. will recommend a transfer date to the two countries' presidents. The Lee Jae-myung administration hopes to reclaim Wartime OPCON by the end of 2027 at the earliest. The U.S. adopts a more cautious stance than South Korea. U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, attending the Asia Security Conference in Singapore on the 30th of last month, described the transfer of South Korea's Wartime OPCON as "encouraging" but emphasized the need to find a "balance" that respects U.S. military operational plans and responsibilities in the transition process. ( 이런 곡절 속에서 한·미는 전작권 환수 뒤 한미연합사를 대체할 미래연합사령부에 대해 1단계인 기본운용능력(IOC) 평가와 검증을 각각 2019년과 2020년 마쳤다. 2단계인 완전운용능력 평가는 2022년 마쳤고, 올해 가을 열리는 제58차 한·미 연례 안보협의회의에서 이를 검증할 계획이다. 한·미 국방장관은 3단계인 완전임무수행능력(FMC) 평가·검증까지 끝낸 뒤 한·미 대통령에게 전환 일자를 건의하게 된다. 이재명 정부는 이르면 2027년 말 전작권 환수를 바란다. 미국은 한국보다 신중한 태도다. 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방부 장관은 지난달 30일 싱가포르에서 열린 아시아안보회의에 참석해 한국의 전작권 전환을 두고 “고무적”이라고 평가하면서도 전환 과정에서는 미군의 작전 계획과 책임을 존중하는 ‘균형’을 찾아야 한다고 강조했다.)

By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr ( 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Few U.S. ground troops are deployed for initial combat on the Korean Peninsula in a contingency (한반도 유사시 초기 전투 투입되는 미국 지상군은 거의 없다)
item.description:
The Lee Jae-myung administration has pledged to retake wartime operational control (OPCON) and aims to complete this by as early as the end of 2027. President Lee expressed his resolve on the 19th, saying, "We are paying for our own defense, so why should the U.S. hold OPCON?" However, the U.S. side maintains that meeting conditions is a priority over timing, proposing a timeline of the first quarter of 2029 (as suggested by Lieutenant General Xavier Brunson, commander of the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command). Amid a temperature difference between South Korea and the U.S., there are voices domestically arguing that "the South Korean military still lacks capability." The Hankyoreh will examine the OPCON transfer issue in three installments, starting with the 6.25 War anniversary. (이재명 정부는 전시작전권 환수를 공약하고 빠르면 2027년 말까지 마무리하려 한다. 이 대통령은 지난 19일 “우리 돈 내며 방위를 책임질 건데, 전작권을 미국이 왜 갖고 있느냐”고 의지를 표명했다. 그러나 미국 쪽은 전작권 전환은 시기보다 조건 충족이 우선이라는 태도를 보이며 시기 역시 2029년 1분기(제이비어 브런슨 한미연합군사령관)를 제시했다. 한-미 간 온도 차가 있는 가운데 국내에서도 “한국군은 아직 능력이 부족하다”는 목소리가 있다. 한겨레는 6·25를 계기로 3회에 걸쳐 전작권 환수 쟁점을 짚어 본다.)

Defense Minister An Kyu-baek stated on the 26th of last month at the first Future National Defense Strategy Committee meeting attended by President Lee Jae-myung in Jinhae-gu, Changwon City, South Gyeongsang Province, "Even if wartime operational control (OPCON) is transferred tomorrow, there would be no major issue in defending ourselves." When President Lee responded, "It shouldn't be 'no major issue,' but rather 'no issue at all,'" Minister An replied, "No issue at all." The transfer of OPCON signifies recovering military sovereignty and possessing the capability to independently conduct war in times of crisis. <<> However, conservatives argue that "the South Korean military still lacks capability" and advocate for a 'cautious' transfer rather than a 'swift' one. They claim the South Korean military, compared to the U.S. military, is deficient in intelligence assets for monitoring North Korea, limited in precision strike capabilities, and lacks a command-and-control system. <<> Yet, among the combined ROK-U.S. forces deployed for the defense of South Korea in a contingency, there is almost no U.S. military power. <<> Ground forces are 99% South Korean. The navy is over 95% South Korean, and the air force is about 90% South Korean. This means that in a crisis on the Korean Peninsula, the South Korean military must assume most of the responsibility for the war. Currently, of the 28,500 U.S. troops stationed in South Korea, 18,000 are Army and 8,000 are Air Force. <<> In particular, U.S. forces in South Korea are not deployed for direct combat in the early stages of war. A government official said, "In the early stages of war, when casualties are high, a significant number of U.S. ground troops are assigned to evacuation operations for U.S. citizens," adding, "The U.S. military is continuously reducing its forces in the operational plans for the Korean Peninsula." <<> President Lee Jae-myung's confidence that "there would be no problem even if OPCON is transferred tomorrow" is based on his assessment that "the Republic of Korea has achieved defense capabilities stronger than at any time in history" (from his Armed Forces Day address last October). <<> According to data from Statistics Korea (now National Data Agency), North Korea's annual nominal GDP in 2024 was approximately 43.7 trillion won, while South Korea's defense budget for the same year was 59.4 trillion won. South Korea's defense spending exceeds the entire size of North Korea's national economy. The gap in defense spending between the two Koreas is estimated at $43.07 billion versus $1.604 billion, a 26-fold difference (2018, Stockholm International Peace Research Institute). North Korea allocates up to 15.8% of its total budget to defense, vowing to "continuously expand and strengthen self-reliant nuclear deterrence and war-fighting capabilities." However, realistically, South Korea's GDP is 59 times larger than North Korea's (as of 2024), making it difficult for the North to close the widening gap. <<> Since 2007, when OPCON transfer preparations began in earnest, the cumulative amount invested in pure force enhancement (excluding personnel costs, etc.) for the South Korean military stands at 176.3 trillion won. This funding has been primarily directed toward building intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) for real-time battlefield awareness, precision strike capabilities to immediately strike enemy strategic and tactical targets, and command-and-control (C2) capabilities for integrating all forces and information to make instantaneous decisions. These efforts have concentrated on strengthening the capabilities set as criteria in the conditional OPCON transfer agreement between South Korea and the U.S. in 2014: ISR, precision strike, and C2. <<> In the past, the South Korean military had to rely on U.S. intelligence assets like reconnaissance satellites and aircraft to track North Korean movements. Until the introduction of the Green Pine radar in 2012 for detecting ballistic missiles, South Korea didn't even know about North Korean ballistic missile launches unless the U.S. provided the information. Lacking an independent surveillance network against the North, South Korea was entirely dependent on U.S. intelligence. <<> But now, the situation has completely changed. <<> South Korea currently operates five independent military reconnaissance satellites capable of checking the Korean Peninsula every two hours. If 30 to 40 additional micro-satellites are successfully launched and operate complementarily with the reconnaissance satellites, it will enable near real-time monitoring of threats from North Korean forces, such as mobile missile launchers. The South Korean military has already deployed four Global Hawk high-altitude reconnaissance drones from the U.S. to monitor North Korea. In April, the first production unit of a domestic strategic-grade UAV, a medium-altitude reconnaissance drone, was delivered. This drone flies at an altitude of over 10 km and monitors ground targets in real time. Lee Seong-chun, a professor emeritus at Dongguk University's Department of North Korean Studies and former director of the Ministry of National Defense's Military Compilation Research Institute, stated, "Our military possesses the capabilities needed to exercise OPCON." <<> In terms of precision strike capabilities, the South Korean military has secured missiles such as Hyunmoo-2, Hyunmoo-3, Hyunmoo-4, and Hyunmoo-5, as well as the long-range air-to-ground missile Taurus. The Hyunmoo-5, deployed to front-line units starting late last year, is a high-power ballistic missile with a warhead weight of about 8 tons, designed to destroy North Korea's underground bunkers. It is considered a key weapon for completing the massive retaliation component of the South Korean three-axis system (Kill Chain – Korean Air and Missile Defense – Massive Punishment and Retaliation) to counter North Korea's nuclear and missile threats. For command and control (C2), the South Korean military operates a battlefield management system that integrates military information management systems like MIMS based on the Joint Command and Control System (KJCCS). <<> Minister An Kyu-baek met with U.S. House and Senate members at the Singapore Asia Security Summit on the 31st of last month and stated, "We fully explained our capabilities, including the fact that South Korea and the U.S. agreed that 94% of the conditions for OPCON transfer as of 2020 have already been met." A senior government official explained, "Based on the criteria agreed upon in 2014, South Korea has already achieved independent operational capabilities in ISR, precision strike, and C2," adding, "These capabilities secured by the South Korean military are those that military powers with strong economies and technologies, such as the U.S., UK, France, and Israel, can possess." <<> Some within the U.S. and South Korean militaries argue that the conditions for OPCON transfer should be revised and supplemented in response to changes in warfare, such as the increased threat from drones, and North Korea's development of new weapons like hypersonic missiles. The rationale is that the South Korean military lacks the ability to counter drones, and North Korea is highly likely to fire a mix of super-large multiple rocket launchers, short-range missiles, various cruise missiles, and hypersonic missiles, necessitating the reinforcement of air defense networks. Some retired and active-duty generals claim that South Korea must possess the same hardware and software as the U.S. military to exercise OPCON, arguing that the transfer is premature. <<> However, critics point out that if conditions continue to change, the OPCON transfer will have no set date. <<> Kim Jeong-sup, a senior research fellow at the Sejong Institute, said, "When President Roh Tae-woo pledged to retake OPCON in his 1987 presidential campaign, there were arguments that it was premature. Nearly 40 years later, despite significant improvements in our military capabilities, the same arguments persist. The transfer of OPCON should be seen not as a matter of conditions or capabilities, but as a matter of will and a policy choice." <<> Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (안규백 국방부 장관은 지난달 26일 경남 창원시 진해구에서 이재명 대통령이 참석한 가운데 열린 제1회 미래국방전략위원회에서 “내일 전시작전통제권(전작권)이 회수되더라도 우리가 스스로 지키는 데는 크게 문제가 없다”고 말했다. 이에 이 대통령이 “크게 문제가 없는 게 아니라 ‘아무 문제가 없다’라고 해야 맞겠죠”라고 하자 안 장관은 “아무 문제가 없다”고 답했다. 전작권 환수는 군사주권을 회복하고, 유사시 전쟁을 스스로 수행하는 능력을 지닌다는 의미를 띤다.)

item.title: Park Jie-won: “Song Young-gil Told President Lee His Intention to Run for Party Leadership… He Said the President Told Him to Do Well” (박지원 “송영길, 이 대통령에 당대표 출마 뜻 밝혀…잘하라고 했다더라”)
item.description:
Amid reports that lawmaker Song Young-gil, a potential candidate for the Democratic Party’s August national convention, had a private dinner with President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Jie-won stated, “Song told President Lee about his decision to run for the party leadership election.” (더불어민주당 8월 전당대회 출마 가능성이 거론되는 송영길 의원이 지난 18일 이재명 대통령과 비공개 만찬을 한 가운데, 박지원 민주당 의원은 “송 의원이 이 대통령에게 전당대회 출마 결심을 얘기했다”고 전했다.)

Appearing on CBS Radio’s “Park Sung-tae’s News Show” on the 24th, Park revealed details of his phone conversation with Song the previous day. (박 의원은 24일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에 나와 전날 송 의원과 나눈 통화 내용을 밝혔다.)

Park said, “When I asked (at the dinner) ‘Did you bring up the party convention matter?’, (Song) said he did discuss the convention, and he told (President Lee) that he would enter a three-way race, eventually unify with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and create a situation where votes coalesce in the runoff.” (박 의원은 “(만찬 자리에서) ‘전당대회 관계(된 주제)는 얘기 안 했느냐’ 했더니, (송 의원은) 전당대회 관계 얘기를 했고 자기가 3자 구도로 가서 결국 김민석 총리와 단일화하는 방안을, 또 결선 투표에서 모아지는 결과를 만들어내겠다, 이런 얘기를 드렸다고 그랬다”고 전했다.)

Park added, “Then I asked, ‘What did the President say?’, and (Song replied) the President showed a positive reaction, effectively telling him to do well.” He continued, “Given that if Representative Jeong Cheong-rae enters (the convention), (Song) would enter to unify the ‘pro-Myung’ faction in a three-way race and then unify in the runoff, the nuance makes one think that Song could potentially become the party leader.” (이어 박 의원은 “‘그래서 대통령께서 뭐라고 하시더냐?’ 그랬더니 긍정적 반응을 보인 것으로, 잘하라고 이런 것으로 말씀을 했다(고 송 의원이 답했다)”고도 했다. 그러면서 “정청래 대표가 (전당대회에) 나가면 자기(송 의원)가 그렇게 나가서 3자 구도로 ‘친명’을 단일화시키고, 또 결선 투표에서 단일화하겠다 하는 걸 보면, 뉘앙스가 만약 그러다가 송 대표가 당 대표가 될 수도 있겠구나, 이런 생각도 들게 했다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, Song had dinner with President Lee at the presidential residence in Hannam-dong, Seoul, on the 18th. Song, a five-term lawmaker who served in Gyeyang-gu, Incheon, resigned his seat to run for Seoul mayor in 2022, and President Lee—then the party’s senior advisor—ran and won the by-election for the same Incheon Gyeyang-gu district. (앞서 송 의원은 지난 18일 서울 한남동 대통령 관저에서 이 대통령과 저녁 식사를 함께했다. 인천 계양을에서 5선을 지낸 송 의원은 2022년 서울시장 선거 출마를 위해 의원직을 내려놓았고 당시 민주당 상임고문이었던 이 대통령이 인천 계양을 보궐선거에 출마해 당선된 바 있다.)

The upcoming Democratic Party leadership election in August is widely expected to be a three-way race among Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and Song. There are many predictions around the party that a “Song Young-gil and Kim Min-seok” united front will form against Jeong. Song has repeatedly stated that he will watch Jeong’s decision on whether to run before finalizing his own candidacy. (오는 8월 열릴 민주당 당대표 선거는 정청래 대표, 김민석 국무총리, 송 의원 3파전으로 치러질 수 있다는 관측에 무게가 실리고 있다. 당 주변에서는 정 대표에 맞서는 ‘송영길-김민석’ 연합 전선이 형성될 것이라는 전망이 많다. 송 의원은 정 대표 출마 여부를 지켜본 뒤 자신의 출마 여부를 최종적으로 결정하겠다는 의사를 여러 차례 밝힌 바 있다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Yong-jin: "In Yo-han is too irresponsible" Park Ji-won: "Should have made an apology to the public" (박용진 “인요한, 너무 무책임” 박지원 “대국민 사과 했어야”)
item.description:
Criticism is mounting from the conservative bloc over the election of former People Power Party lawmaker In Yo-han as chairman of the Korean Red Cross, a public institution under the Ministry of Health and Welfare. <<> Park Yong-jin, deputy chairperson of the Regulatory Reform Committee under the President, said on the 24th regarding this appointment: "A person who acted irresponsibly as the head of the Korean Red Cross—what is this? I found it puzzling." <<> Deputy Chair Park appeared on KBS Radio's "Full Interview" that day and stated: "Former lawmaker In Yo-han has never verbally stated or criticized that he disagreed with the December 3 martial law order; rather, I got the feeling he sided with it. The lawmaker added: "There are discussions about whether it was truly necessary to appoint him, especially amid the extreme situation among the conservative base." <<> Former lawmaker In, regarding former President Yoon Seok-yeol who declared martial law on December 3, expressed: "I understand him emotionally," abstained from the impeachment vote, and blamed the opposition, saying things like "If it were the old Kim Dae-jung's opposition party, they would have embraced him," defending martial law before resigning his legislative seat on December 11 last year, stating, "I will return to my primary duty to contribute to national unity and development." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (인요한 전 국민의힘 의원이 보건복지부 산하 공공기관인 대한적십자사 회장으로 선출된 것을 두고 여권에서 비판이 이어지고 있다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Jeong Cheong-rae Resigns as Democratic Party Leader ([속보] 정청래, 민주당 대표직 사퇴)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, resigned from his position as party leader on the 24th. This appears to be a move to run for re-election in the upcoming party convention. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 24일 대표직을 사퇴했다. 전당대회에 출마하며 연임에 도전하기 위한 것으로 보인다.)

Jeong said at the conclusion of the Supreme Council meeting that morning, "I am stepping down from the party leadership today." (정 대표는 이날 오전 최고위원회의를 마치며 “저는 오늘 당 대표직을 내려 놓는다”라고 말했다.)

This approach is similar to that of President Lee Jae-myung two years ago, when he signaled his intention to seek re-election as Democratic Party leader two days before the formation of the party convention preparation committee. At that time, President Lee held a separate press conference after the Supreme Council meeting to announce his resignation from the party leadership, stating, "If I had definitively decided not to run (in the party convention), I would not have resigned." Jeong appears to have followed President Lee's precedent in his resignation. (2년 전 같은 날 이재명 대통령이 전당대회준비위원회 구성 이틀 앞두고 민주당 대표직 연임의 뜻을 내비친 것과 유사한 방식이다. 당시 이 대통령은 최고위원회의를 마치고 별도의 기자회견을 열어 대표직에서 물러나겠다고 밝히며 “아무래도 (전당대회에) 출마하지 않겠다고 확정했다면 사퇴하지 않았을 것”이라고 발언했다. 정 대표도 이 대통령의 전례를 따라 사퇴한 것으로 보인다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: North Korea Deploys New 5,000-Ton-Class Destroyer; Kim Jong Un Calls for 'Nuclear Arming' of Navy (북, 5000t급 신형 구축함 실전 배치…김정은 “해군 핵무장화”)
item.description:
North Korea has deployed a new 5,000-ton-class destroyer, the *Choe Hyon Ho*, for active duty. <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 24th that a commissioning ceremony for the *Choe Hyon Ho* was held at Nampo Port the previous day, attended by State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un. In his speech at the ceremony, Chairman Kim stated, "We have achieved satisfactory results, confirming that our ship possesses the most perfect comprehensive operational combat capabilities." He directly mentioned that the navy had previously been evaluated as the weakest among North Korea's military branches, emphasizing, "That has now changed. The combat power of our navy will become something miraculous, beyond imagination." <<> Chairman Kim then declared, "The era when the navy existed as a force for coastal defense is now firmly in the past," adding, "The navy is proudly growing into a military branch equipped with strategic means, and the nuclear arming of the navy is precisely following its own course." He once again stressed the importance of nuclear forces. The remarks also appeared to indicate North Korea's intent for its navy to move beyond coastal defense into Northeast Asia and the open ocean, possibly with an eye on cooperation with China and Russia. <<> He attached significance to the naval buildup, stating it is "a very important strategic process that will make our national nuclear forces more multifaceted and effectively operational by further clarifying a strong and reliable nuclear war deterrent, and will firmly secure the initiative in military activities for maritime defense and war deterrence." <<> Specific plans to rapidly strengthen the North Korean navy's military power were also disclosed. Chairman Kim emphasized, "During the five-year plan period, we must accurately implement all plans regarding naval force construction, including producing (building) two *Choe Hyon*-class or larger surface ships each year, including 10,000-ton-class cruisers, as well as building frigates and special-purpose ships, and developing and producing underwater weapons systems." <<> Chairman Kim remarked that there were no bases to dock large combat ships like the *Choe Hyon Ho*, calling this "a happy problem to have." He stated, "In the past, it could be said that such bases were not needed. However, now the construction of modern naval bases has emerged as an urgent and essential task," reiterating that the decision to build a navy fleet base was made at the 9th Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 2nd Session of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, held from the 20th to the 22nd. <<> Chairman Kim added that the *Kang Gon Ho*, which ran aground during its launching ceremony last year and is currently undergoing performance tests, will also be deployed for operations soon, and that "following that, we plan to continuously launch 10,000-ton-class strategic ships into the sea." <<> After finishing his speech, Chairman Kim boarded the *Choe Hyon Ho* to encourage the service members. KCNA reported that the *Choe Hyon Ho*, having completed its commissioning ceremony that day, "will be commissioned into the West Sea Fleet of the Korean People's Army Navy, pursuant to orders from the Party Central Military Commission, to carry out the honorable mission of defending the Republic's western maritime territory and deterring war." <<> KCNA reported that participants in the ceremony included officials from the Party Central leadership, such as members of the Political Bureau Presidium, military commanders, navy personnel, and officials from the shipbuilding industry. Photos released by North Korean media show Chairman Kim accompanied by Party Secretaries Jo Chun Ryong and Jong Kyong Taek, Ministry of National Defense Advisor Pak Jong Chon, Minister of Shipbuilding Industry Kim Kwang Il, Vice Minister of National Defense and Director General of the General Equipment Bureau Kim Kang Il, and Air Force Commander Kim Kwang Hyok. Ju Ae, who had accompanied Chairman Kim during sea performance tests of the *Choe Hyon Ho* and *Kang Gon Ho*, did not appear to participate in this commissioning ceremony. <<> North Korea first held the launch ceremony for the *Choe Hyon Ho* at the Nampo Shipyard last year, coinciding with the anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (partisans, April 25th). The ship's name, *Choe Hyon*, comes from Choe Hyon, a partisan soldier and close confidant of Kim Il Sung who served as Minister of the People's Armed Forces. Choe Hyon was also the father of former Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly President Choe Ryong Hae. Since the launch ceremony, North Korea appears to have been improving the ship's weapons performance through tests, including missile launch trials. <<> While North Korea emphasizes that the ship was built with its own technology, experts analyzed that the close-in weapon system (CIWS) of the *Choe Hyon Ho*, captured in photos from the day, appears similar to the Russian naval air defense system 'Pantsir-ME,' suggesting the possibility of Russian technical support. <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (북한이 5천t급 신형 구축함 ‘최현호’를 실전 배치했다.)

item.title: “Do you understand Yoon Suk-yeol with your heart?”... Even the ruling party says, “In Yo-han must clarify his actions during the insurrection crisis” (“윤석열 가슴으로 이해한다”고?…여권도 “인요한, 내란 정국 행보 소명해야”)
item.description:
A ruling party official said regarding former People Power Party lawmaker In Yo-han, who was elected as the new president of the Korean Red Cross after defending the December 3 martial law, “He must account for himself and make a gesture to seek understanding from the public.” Under the Korean Red Cross Organization Act, In must receive approval from President Lee Jae-myung, the honorary chairperson, before he can assume his duties. (12·3 비상계엄을 옹호한 인요한 전 국민의힘 의원이 대한적십자사 신임 회장으로 선출된 데 대해 여권 관계자가 “스스로 소명하고, 국민들에게 이해를 구하는 제스처가 나와야 한다”고 말했다. 인 전 의원은 대한적십자사 조직법에 따라 명예회장인 이재명 대통령의 인준을 거쳐야 회장 직무를 수행할 수 있다.)

On the 24th, a ruling party official said, “He must clearly explain his activities during the insurrection crisis. While the focus is on being a figure of unity, he needs to address what he can resolve. During the December 3 martial law, when citizens were fighting in the cold streets, why wasn’t he with them? He must explain and clarify that process.” It appears likely that President Lee will decide whether to approve him after observing what stance In takes. (여권 관계자는 24일 “내란 정국에 본인이 활동한 부분에 대해 명확히 말해야 한다”며 “통합인사의 방점은 맞지만, 본인이 해소할 부분은 해소해야 한다. 국민들이 12·3 비상계엄 당시 추운 바닥에서 싸우고 있을 때, 본인은 왜 함께하지 않았는지 그 과정을 설명하고 명확히 해야 한다”고 말했다. 인 전 의원이 어떤 입장을 내놓는지 지켜본 뒤, 이 대통령이 인준 여부를 결정할 가능성이 커 보인다.)

Previously, when former Minister of Planning and Budget nominee Lee Hye-hoon’s comments defending martial law sparked controversy in December last year, President Lee said, “Regarding statements related to insurrection, the individual must directly and sufficiently account for themselves and express their intent to break away.” <<>> On the 22nd, former lawmaker In was elected as the 32nd president of the Korean Red Cross. On the 23rd, In released a statement saying, “Instead of a thousand words about the damage to constitutional order and the national misfortune caused by illegal martial law, I practiced my conviction with one action: resigning from my parliamentary seat.” However, In said in a media interview in February last year, “I saw bulldozer-like behavior from the Democratic Party of Korea, worse than Chun Doo-hwan, so I understand, with my heart, former President Yoon Suk-yeol’s declaration of martial law.” In suddenly resigned from his parliamentary seat in December last year but did not issue an apology or reflection on the December 3 martial law. (앞서 이 대통령은 지난해 12월 이혜훈 전 기획예산처 후보자의 계엄 옹호 발언이 논란이 됐을 때도 “내란 관련 발언에 대해서는 본인이 직접 충분히 소명해야 하고, 단절할 의사를 표명해야 하는 게 맞는다”는 취지로 말한 바 있다.)

The Fatherland Innovation Party and others are opposing In’s election as president of the Korean Red Cross. Park Byung-eon, senior spokesperson for the Fatherland Innovation Party, said in a written briefing on the same day, “Former lawmaker In is a person who defended the martial law by saying ‘I understand former President Yoon Suk-yeol with my heart’ and opposed impeachment. President Lee should consider rejecting the approval of In Yo-han as the Red Cross president.” People Power Party lawmaker Han Ji-ah also said on Facebook the previous day, “Former lawmaker In said he ‘understands with his heart’ former President Yoon regarding the martial law and publicly opposed impeachment. I want to ask whether appointing such a person as president is truly the ‘liquidation of insurrection’ and ‘pragmatism’ this government talks about.” (지난 22일 인 전 의원은 제32대 대한적십자사 회장으로 선출됐다. 인 전 의원은 23일 입장을 내고 “저는 불법 계엄으로 초래된 헌정 질서 훼손과 국민적 불행에 대해 천 가지 말 대신 의원직 사퇴라는 하나의 행동으로 소신을 실천했다”고 말했다. 하지만 인 전 의원은 지난해 2월 언론 인터뷰에서 “더불어민주당에서 불도저 짓, 전두환보다 더한 정치를 봤다”며 “그래서 가슴으로는 윤석열 전 대통령의 (비상계엄 선포)를 이해한다”고 말했다. 지난해 12월 인 전 의원은 의원직을 전격 사퇴했지만 12·3 비상계엄에 대한 사과나 반성 메시지는 내놓지 않았다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (조국혁신당 등은 인 전 의원의 대한적십자사 회장 선출에 반발하고 있다. 박병언 조국혁신당 선임대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑에서 “인 전 의원은 ‘윤석열 전 대통령을 가슴으로 이해한다’며 계엄을 옹호하고 탄핵을 반대해 온 인사”라며 “이 대통령은 인요한 대한적십자 회장 인준 거부를 검토해 달라”고 요청했다. 한지아 국민의힘 의원도 전날 페이스북에 “인 전 의원은 비상계엄과 관련해 윤 전 대통령을 ‘가슴으로 이해한다’고 말했고 탄핵에도 공개적으로 반대했다”며 “그런 인물을 회장으로 임명하는 것이 과연 이번 정부가 말하는 ‘내란 청산’이고 ‘실용’인지 묻고 싶다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom "Second Semiconductor Cluster to Be Announced Soon… Yongin Cluster Remains as Planned" (김용범 “반도체 제2클러스터 조만간 발표…용인 클러스터 그대로”)
item.description:
On the 24th, Kim Yong-beom, head of the Presidential Office's Policy Office, stated regarding Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix reviewing plans to expand semiconductor cluster investments in Honam, "Discussions are approaching the final stages, and once finalized, a meeting will be held soon with companies and ministries to explain to the public." (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 24일 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 호남에 반도체 클러스터 투자 확대 방안을 검토하는 것과 관련해 “논의가 마무리 단계에 다가오고 있어 확정이 되면 기업·부처가 모여 국민께 설명드리는 자리가 조만간 마련될 것”이라고 말했다.)

At the Gwanhun Club debate held at the Seoul Press Center that day, Director Kim said, "It is true that serious discussions are underway between the two companies, ministries, and the government on how to determine the location of the semiconductor cluster," but added, "It is absolutely not the case that we will abandon the planned semiconductor cluster in Yongin and move to the provinces." (김 실장은 이날 서울 프레스센터에서 열린 관훈토론회에서 “두 개의 기업과 부처, 정부 간 (반도체 클러스터) 입지를 어떻게 정해야 할지 진지한 논의가 이뤄지는 건 사실”이라면서도 “용인에 짓기로 한 반도체 클러스터를 짓지 않고 지방으로 가는 건 절대로 아니다”라고 말했다.)

This suggests that the government is actively reviewing plans to additionally create a large-scale semiconductor production base in non-capital areas, including Honam. However, it appears to clarify that this is not a revision of the existing Yongin semiconductor cluster plan, but rather a discussion to address additional demand arising from the semiconductor boom. (정부가 호남을 포함한 비수도권에 대규모 반도체 생산 거점을 추가로 조성하는 방안을 본격 검토하고 있음을 시사한 것이다. 다만 기존 용인 반도체 클러스터 계획을 수정하는 것이 아니라, 반도체 호황에 따른 추가 수요에 대응하기 위한 차원의 논의라는 점을 분명히 한 것으로 보인다.)

Director Kim continued, "Key semiconductor fabs in Korea are located in Pyeongtaek, Yongin, Icheon, and Cheongju. Samsung is building a large new one in Yongin, and Hynix has decided to build four giant fabs near Yongin. Samsung has also announced around six on a phased basis. However, demand from Samsung and Hynix is exploding, so the anticipated capital area clusters, originally planned for 2044 and 2048, must be completed earlier by 2034 and 2035." (김 실장은 이어 “평택, 용인, 이천, 청주 등에 우리나라 반도체의 주요 팹(Fab)들이 위치해 있는데, 삼성도 용인에 새로 크게 짓고, 하이닉스도 용인 쪽에 거대 팹을 네 개 짓기로 했다. 삼성도 6개 정도를 연차별로 발표했다”며 “그런데 삼성과 하이닉스의 수요가 폭발적으로 늘고 있어서 2044년, 2048년까지 예고된 수도권 클러스터를 2034년, 2035년까지 당겨서 완성해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Director Kim also said, "We must also prepare for the period after that. There is no more land in the capital area, and power and water supply are also impossible, so there is a need to find a second cluster to prepare for 7-8 years from now. As a government, we are at the stage of seriously discussing how to support the enormous site and water supply." (김 실장은 또 “그 이후도 대비해야 한다. 수도권에는 더 땅이 없고, 전력·용수도 불가능하기 때문에 7~8년 뒤를 대비한 제2클러스터를 찾아야 할 필요가 있다”며 “정부로서도 거대한 부지, 용수를 어떻게 지원할지 진지하게 논의하고 있는 단계”라고 말했다.)

Director Kim also proposed a social discussion on excess tax revenue. He said, "We need to examine how the fruits of growth in the AI era should be shared. Social discussions on social policy, labor policy, and the use of excess tax revenue are necessary. AI can make the country wealthy, but there is no guarantee that all citizens will enjoy the benefits equally. This is the problem of K-shaped growth." (김 실장은 초과세수에 대한 사회적 논의도 제안했다. 김 실장은 “인공지능(AI) 시대 성장의 과실은 어떻게 공유돼야 하는지 들여다봐야 한다. 사회정책과 노동정책, 그리고 초과세수 활용에 대한 사회적 논의가 필요하다”며 “인공지능은 국가를 부유하게 만들 수 있지만 모든 국민이 혜택을 동일하게 누린다는 보장은 없다. 케이(K)자 성장의 문제”라고 말했다.)

Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Go Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Audit Board Chief: "Data collection for election commission accounting audit begins…On-site audit expected in July" (감사원장 “선관위 회계감사 자료수집 시작…7월 실지감사 예상”)
item.description:
Audit Board Chief Kim Ho-cheol announced on the 24th that an accounting audit has commenced on the National Election Commission regarding the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections. (김호철 감사원장이 24일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 중앙선거관리위원회에 대한 회계감사에 돌입했다고 밝혔다.)

Chief Kim stated at a press briefing held at the Board of Audit and Inspection in Jongno-gu, Seoul, "Following a resolution by the Audit Committee yesterday, we began collecting data for the accounting audit today." He added, "The citizens are deeply concerned and worried about this incomprehensible infringement of voting rights during the election. We plan to collect data, determine the scope and duration of the audit, and select the audit items. We expect the on-site audit to begin around July." (김 원장은 이날 서울 종로구 감사원에서 열린 기자간담회에서 “어제 감사위원회 의결을 거쳐 오늘 회계감사를 위한 자료 수집에 나섰다”고 말했다. 김 원장은 “국민께서 납득할 수 없는 선거에서의 참정권 침해 사태에 대해 국민의 지대한 관심이 있으시고, 우려가 높은 상황”이라며 “자료를 수집해 감사의 범위와 기간 등을 정하고 감사 사항을 선정하는 대로 대략 7월 정도에는 저희가 실지감사에 나설 것으로 예상하고 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim continued, "Accounting audits of constitutional institutions are a duty under the Board of Audit and Inspection Act, so we have been conducting periodic and regular accounting audits. However, respecting the Constitutional Court's decision, we cannot conduct a performance inspection of the Election Commission." (김 원장은 이어 “헌법기관들에 대한 회계감사는 감사원법상 책무이기 때문에 주기적, 정기적 회계감사를 실시해 왔다”며 “헌법재판소의 결정을 존중해 선관위에 대한 직무감찰은 할 수 없는 상황”이라고 말했다.)

Chief Kim further said, "We will collect data and synthesize the emerging facts to select the items for the accounting audit. Matters such as improper expenditures for election expenses, inadequate settlement of election costs, and neglect in management—like improper procurement or abandonment of election equipment or supplies—could have been pointed out in previous audits as well. We have continuously demanded corrective actions on such issues." (김 원장은 그러면서 “자료를 수집하고 드러나는 사실관계를 종합해 할 수 있는 회계감사 사항을 선정할 것”이라며 “선거경비 목적의 지출, 부실한 선거경비 정산, 선거장비나 물품 등 부당하게 구입하거나 방치하는 등 관리를 제대로 못하는 것들에 대해선 그 이전 감사에서도 지적될 수 있었던 사안이다. 그런 시정을 저희가 계속 요구를 해 왔다”고 덧붙였다.)
